_comment: Hidden high-scale diagnostics contract: exactly five CPU rows, all registered outside the frozen L1B Authoring.*/WriteScaling.* selection. The four WriteScalingHighN.* rows reuse the WriteScaling fixture and operation at 8,192 and 16,384 bodies; RuntimeSpawnScaling.collider_heavy_1280_cpu drains one runtime-spawned body into 1,280 existing static colliders.
